Definition: linsey-woolsey, i.e. cloth of linen and wool carded and spun together
BiblicalUsage: 1) mixed stuff, fabric of mixed weave, linsey-woolsey; 1a) a kind of cloth forbidden for garments; 1b) cloth made by weaving linen and wool together
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
